title: Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees: Activity Types, Grades, Campus Levels and Seasons
content:
Calloway Creek ISD registers every student activity under one of the seven official activity types of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees**. The type decides the kind of program, whose eligibility rules govern it, which grades and campus levels it admits, which activities are registered under it, how many participations of the type a student may hold in one season, whether roster spots go by tryouts and whether the district transports participants.

## Catalogue of activity types

| Activity type | Kind of program | Rules that govern | Grades admitted | Campus levels where it runs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Campus Club Membership | club | campus | KG through 12 | elementary, middle, high |
| UIL Academic and Robotics Team | academic competition | UIL | 02 through 12 | elementary, middle, high |
| Middle School UIL Athletics | athletics | UIL | 07 and 08 | middle |
| Fine Arts Performing Ensemble | fine arts | UIL | 06 through 12 | middle, high |
| High School UIL Athletics | athletics | UIL | 09 through 12 | high |
| Cheer and Dance Team | spirit | UIL | 07 through 12 | middle, high |
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | field trip | campus | 05 | elementary |

## Activities registered under each type

| Activity type | Activities |
|---|---|
| Campus Club Membership | student council, National Junior Honor Society, chess club, FFA, art club |
| UIL Academic and Robotics Team | UIL academics, robotics, one-act play |
| Middle School UIL Athletics | football, volleyball, cross country, basketball, soccer, track and field, tennis |
| Fine Arts Performing Ensemble | band, choir, orchestra, theatre |
| High School UIL Athletics | football, volleyball, cross country, basketball, soccer, wrestling, swimming, track and field, baseball, softball, tennis, golf |
| Cheer and Dance Team | cheerleading, dance team |
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | outdoor school |

## Season limits, tryouts and transportation

| Activity type | Most participations of the type in one season | Roster spots decided by tryouts | District transports participants to contests, performances or the trip |
|---|---|---|---|
| Campus Club Membership | 4 | no | no |
| UIL Academic and Robotics Team | 3 | no | yes |
| Middle School UIL Athletics | 1 | no | yes |
| Fine Arts Performing Ensemble | 3 | no | yes |
| High School UIL Athletics | 1 | yes | yes |
| Cheer and Dance Team | 1 | yes | yes |
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | 1 | no | yes |

**Season start dates.** For every activity type the first practice or event date of each season of the school year is August 3 for the fall season, October 26 for the winter season and January 4 for the spring season.

## Points of reading

- The grades a type admits are a list: a Grade 7 student fits Middle School UIL Athletics, Fine Arts Performing Ensemble, Cheer and Dance Team, the UIL Academic and Robotics Team and Campus Club Membership, but not High School UIL Athletics or the Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip.
- The season limit counts participations of the same activity type: under Campus Club Membership a student may hold up to 4 club participations in one season, while under High School UIL Athletics a student holds at most 1 in a season.
